app.name: Fallow
app.one_liner: Rust-native, zero-config static analysis for TypeScript/JavaScript that detects unused code, duplication, complexity, and architecture drift with optional runtime intelligence.

screens.name: Audit Dashboard
screens.purpose: Display aggregated findings from static and optional runtime analysis including unused exports, clone families, complexity hotspots, and boundary violations.

rust_commands.name: audit
rust_commands.purpose: Perform static (and optionally runtime) analysis across the entire codebase to detect issues like unused code, duplication, and architecture drift.

rust_commands.name: explain
rust_commands.purpose: Provide detailed explanations for specific findings; currently exhibits no-op behavior in human output and combined-mode JSON.

rust_commands.name: fix
rust_commands.purpose: Apply automated fixes for detected issues, such as removing unused exports or catalog entries, with support for comment block handling.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add basic CI output formatting
week 1: Implement core audit command with static analysis
acceptance_tests: Review envelopes include both summary and inline comments with reconciliation fingerprints.
Running fallow audit --diff-file filters all finding types to changed lines only.
The --explain flag produces visible output in human-readable mode.
Windows CI correctly reports expected count of unused exports in snapshot tests.
